info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Replace Ecommerce Cart Merge-v1-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Merge API enables businesses to consolidate items from multiple shopping carts into a single cart, enhancing the customer experience during the checkout process. This API supports the merging of cart contents seamlessly, allowing users to retain their selected items while simplifying their purchasing journey. Typically utilized by ecommerce platforms and payment processors, this API caters to scenarios where users may switch devices or update their shopping preferences. With this functionality, merchants can improve conversion rates and reduce cart abandonment.

put.summary: Merge items from one cart to another.
put.description: This endpoint allows the user to merge items from a specified source cart into the target cart, ensuring that all items are consolidated while avoiding duplicates. It streamlines the user's shopping experience by combining selections efficiently.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to merge items from one shopping cart into another. Ensure that the items being merged are properly formatted according to the schema provided. The operation will consolidate the contents of the carts into a single cart. Please provide the necessary details as per the specified schema.
